text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Happy b-day to me~~!! So yeah, Tap-poyo, 
come to my birthday party~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh! A party hosted by Helios? Sounds 
great, I'd love to—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to, but... Truth is, I was 
thinking of sending an invitation too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The crew and I really went all out 
preparing Helios's birthday party! Pizza, 
snacks, and donuts! A whole mountain of 
'em!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat~?! By friends, you mean Tappoyo's 
usual crew?! How are they?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, why don't we all just head over 
there instead! A giant karaoke room! With 
a sparkling disco ball â We can have a 
karaoke showdown till we lose our voices!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, are you dissatisfied with our 
party? We're pros when it comes to 
banquets. We're already prepping to make 
sure Helios has the absolute best time.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh? But I'm a party pro, y'know? 
Morning party, noon party, night 
party—party people 24/7!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Not backing down, huh... Which means...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Heh... There's no other choice but to 
combine them!! The pizza, the donuts—bring 
everything we prepared into the tub!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you bet! All our friends are gonna 
storm the place! Let's party hard the 
whole day long!
